title: p0142
universal_lens: The perception of space is formalized as a multi-modal volumetric tensor field. Heterogeneous sensory inputs (auditory, tactile, proprioceptive) are mapped to an intrinsic extensive scalar, establishing a unified geometric manifold where subjective spatial magnitude dictates the underlying metric structure.
gsi_mapping: Sensory voluminousness acts as a conformal prior in Bayesian inference. High-dimensional telemetry from disparate sources is collapsed into a scalar extensity measure, dynamically updating posterior probabilities regarding spatial occupancy and event magnitude within the GSI probabilistic framework.
gse_mapping: Spatial extensity governs state transitions in the GSE situational graph. Proprioceptive and vestibular feedback modulate the local metric tensor, dictating agent trajectory planning and collision avoidance by quantifying the volumetric footprint of immediate environmental interactions.

primitives.name: Crude Extensity Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: In the sensations of hearing, touch, sight, and pain we are accustomed to distinguish from among the other elements the element of voluminousness.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: V: Voluminousness (dimensionless scalar), S: Sensory input vector (heterogeneous SI units)
primitives.assumptions: All sensory modalities possess an intrinsic, extractable spatial dimension independent of their primary physical stimulus.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails for strictly non-spatial or purely temporal stimuli lacking any perceived extension or mass.

layer2.mapping: Maps heterogeneous sensory streams to a unified volumetric scalar field, serving as the foundational metric for spatial reasoning in GSE.
layer2.telemetry: Subjective magnitude ratings across distinct sensory modalities.

primitives.name: Subjective Motion Metric
primitives.verbatim_quote: In the sensation of dizziness or subjective motion, which recent investigation has proved to be connected with stimulation of the semi-circular canals of the ear, the spatial character is very prominent.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: M: Subjective motion (rad/s), C: Semi-circular canal stimulation (pressure gradient Pa/m)
primitives.assumptions: Vestibular fluid dynamics directly induce a high-fidelity spatial coordinate transformation in the perceptual manifold.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities occur during sensory conflict (e.g., motion sickness) where visual and vestibular metrics diverge irreconcilably.

layer2.mapping: Derives instantaneous rotational velocity vectors from biological canal stimulation, feeding directly into GSE inertial navigation subroutines.
layer2.telemetry: Caloric test responses and angular acceleration tracking.

primitives.name: Muscular Extent Gradient
primitives.verbatim_quote: Under these circumstances we shall do better to adjourn its consideration ; admitting, however, that it seems at first sight as if we felt something decidedly more voluminous when we contract our thigh-muscles than when we twitch an eyelid or some small muscle in the face.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: E_m: Muscular extent (m^3 equivalent), F: Muscle contraction force (N)
primitives.assumptions: The perceived spatial volume of a muscle group scales monotonically with its physical mass and activation force.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down under extreme fatigue or neurological dampening where force output decouples from spatial awareness.

layer2.mapping: Quantifies the 'mass' of an agent's action potential, mapping muscular recruitment to volumetric displacement in the GSE tactical layer.
layer2.telemetry: EMG amplitude correlated with joint angle displacement.
